following_object.name: ROM_FIXED_WIDTH_BLANK_RECORDS_126D4E
following_object.description: Three unselected FF/space/NUL fixed-width records after the live sentinel and before SCENE_RESOURCE_MODE_RECORD_TABLE; no runtime consumer is established.

evidence: Previous/next selection moves the pointer by exactly 0x10 bytes and rejects a first-byte 0xFF sentinel.
The ROM contains 94 consecutive command/label records followed by one complete 0xFF sentinel record.
Every record occupies exactly 16 bytes and ends with a NUL-padded display label.
